description: The figure presents a task taxonomy for the MMAR benchmark, visualized as a concentric ring chart that categorizes tasks into three primary layers: Perception Layer, Semantic Layer, and Content Analysis. The outermost ring, labeled "Content Analysis," is divided into two main segments: "Semantic Layer (41.2%)" and "Perception Layer (40.4%)." The "Semantic Layer" is further subdivided into "Emotion & Intention," "Speaker Analysis," and "Environmental Perception & Reasoning." The "Perception Layer" includes "Music Theory," "Counting & Statistics," "Correlation Analysis," "Temporal Analysis," and "Spatial Analysis." The innermost ring, "Signal Layer (4.3%)," is composed of "Anomaly Detection," "Acoustic Quality Analysis," and "Imagination." The "Cultural Layer (14.1%)" is situated between the Perception and Semantic layers and includes "Culture of Speaker" and "Professional Knowl & Reasoning." The chart uses a color gradient from light to dark blue to differentiate the layers and their subtasks, with percentage values explicitly labeled for each main layer.
